name: qa-autopilot
description: AI-powered frontend QA automation engine with self-healing selectors

scripts.start: pnpm run setup && pnpm run dev
scripts.setup: pnpm run setup:engine && pnpm run setup:web
scripts.setup:engine: test -d engine/.venv || python3 -m venv engine/.venv && engine/.venv/bin/pip install --upgrade pip && engine/.venv/bin/pip install -e engine
scripts.dev: concurrently --names engine,web --prefix-colors blue,green --kill-others-on-fail "pnpm run dev:engine" "pnpm run dev:web"
